tasks.eng6-pronouns-types: Topic: Pronouns (Grade 6 English Home Language, Term 1). Cover what a pronoun does (takes the place of a noun), interrogative pronouns (who, whom, whose, what, which), demonstrative pronouns (this, that, these, those, standing alone) and indefinite pronouns (someone, everyone, nobody, something, nothing, all, some, many, few; everyone and nothing take a singular verb). Use South African English spelling and invented names. Ask Grade 6 learners to identify and choose the right pronoun, with exactly one correct option and no sentence where a different option is also grammatical.
tasks.eng6-subject-verb-agreement: Topic: Subject-verb agreement and the simple tenses (Grade 6 English Home Language, Term 1). Cover subject and verb, a singular subject with a singular verb and a plural subject with a plural verb, a subject joined by and being plural, the verb to be (I am, he is, they are), and the simple present, simple past (regular -ed and irregular went, ate, saw) and simple future (will plus the plain verb) with time words. Ask Grade 6 learners to choose the correct verb form with exactly one correct option.
tasks.eng6-prepositions: Topic: Prepositions (Grade 6 English Home Language, Term 1). Cover prepositions of place (in, on, under, behind, between for two, among for many, next to), of time (at with clock times, on with days and dates, in with months, years and parts of the day, before, after, during) and of direction (to, into, across, through, along, towards). Ask Grade 6 learners to identify prepositions and choose the correct one with exactly one correct option.
tasks.eng6-prefixes-suffixes-stems: Topic: Stems, prefixes and suffixes (Grade 6 English Home Language, Term 2). Cover the stem (root) of a word, prefixes (un not, re again, dis opposite, mis wrongly, pre before), suffixes (ful full of, less without, ness state, ly how, er a person who, ment), word division between syllables with a hyphen, alphabetical order and guide words in a dictionary. Use South African English spelling. Ask Grade 6 learners to identify and add prefixes and suffixes with exactly one correct option.
tasks.eng6-continuous-present-perfect: Topic: Continuous tenses and the present perfect (Grade 6 English Home Language, Term 2). Cover auxiliary verbs (am, is, are, was, were, has, have, will), the present continuous (am, is or are plus ing), the past continuous (was or were plus ing), the future continuous (will be plus ing), the present perfect (has or have plus the past participle, including eaten, gone, seen, written) and time clues (now, when I phoned, tomorrow at ten, already). Ask Grade 6 learners to choose the correct verb form with exactly one correct option.
